text:
The plate holds green beans (possibly long beans) and two corn cobettes (short cross-cut pieces of cob).

Green beans: about 15 pieces, roughly 70 g, at about 31 kcal per 100 g, so about 22 kcal. They may be cooked with a little oil, which would add a few more, so I'll call it about 30 kcal.

Corn: two pieces about 2.5 cm thick. Each is roughly 40 g of kernels plus cob, so about 80 g in total. Corn is about 90 kcal per 100 g, and the cob adds mass but no calories. That gives about 60 kcal.

Total: about 90 kcal for about 150 g of food.
